data.one_liner: A Flutter heatmap calendar package supporting internationalization and UTC.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable heatmap calendar widget to display data over time spans. It supports configurations for cells, labels, layouts, and colors, with good performance for large date ranges.
use_when: You need to display contribution-style heatmap calendars like GitHub.
You want to visualize activity or event data over a large time span.
avoid_when: You need standard charts like line, bar, or pie charts.
strengths: Good performance when dealing with a large time span.
Supports internationalization and UTC time zones.
weaknesses: Limited to heatmap calendar visualizations only.
